user_query: I want to get color ideas for my painting, including named colors and random colors with detailed color values.

TaskList.description: Generate two random named colors and retrieve their color details including RGB, CMYK, HEX, HSL, HSV, web-safe status, color names, and nearest color matches.
Generate two random colors (not necessarily named) and retrieve their color details including RGB, CMYK, HEX, HSL, HSV, web-safe status, color names, and nearest color matches.
